notes: The submitter's own home: one page listing every proposal a person has sent this conference and its status, reached by a magic link and no password. The band covers the door's no-oracle answer, its request-then-verify silence before the mail is opened, conference scoping across a two-conference submitter, reference codes and the standing decision on every row, the pre-launch open-call door, the per-mailbox mail ceiling, and the sessionless page itself. AC-419, AC-421, and AC-422 were added at review: a reversed acceptance must stop claiming it was accepted (driven through the real cascade, not a synthesized decision row), an unlaunched conference must not be named to a stranger or silently swapped for another, and duplicate-slug resolution must be deterministic while keeping candidates inside its selected organization. AC-420 was struck because the schema has no durable announcement signal; MRQ-283 owns that migration-backed follow-up.
